segments.an3.20:1.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko nacirasseva mahattaṃ vepullattaṃ [mahantattaṃ vā vepullattaṃ vā (pī. ka.)] pāpuṇāti bhogesu.
segments.an3.20:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko cakkhumā ca hoti vidhuro ca nissayasampanno ca.
segments.an3.20:1.6: ‘idaṃ paṇiyaṃ evaṃ kītaṃ, evaṃ vikkayamānaṃ [vikkīyamānaṃ (?)], ettakaṃ mūlaṃ bhavissati, ettako udayo’ti [uddayoti (sī.)].
segments.an3.20:1.7: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko cakkhumā hoti.
segments.an3.20:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko kusalo hoti paṇiyaṃ ketuñca vikketuñca.
segments.an3.20:2.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko vidhuro hoti.
segments.an3.20:3.2: Idha bhikkhave, pāpaṇikaṃ ye te gahapatī vā gahapatiputtā vā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā te evaṃ jānanti –
segments.an3.20:3.3: ‘ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ pāpaṇiko cakkhumā vidhuro ca paṭibalo puttadārañca posetuṃ, amhākañca kālena kālaṃ anuppadātun’ti.
segments.an3.20:3.5: ‘ito, samma pāpaṇika, bhoge karitvā [haritvā (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] puttadārañca posehi, amhākañca kālena kālaṃ anuppadehī’ti.
segments.an3.20:3.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko nissayasampanno hoti.
segments.an3.20:3.7: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato pāpaṇiko nacirasseva mahattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti bhogesu.
segments.an3.20:4.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva mahattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.an3.20:4.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhumā ca hoti vidhuro ca nissayasampanno ca.
segments.an3.20:4.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
segments.an3.20:4.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhumā hoti.
segments.an3.20:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.an3.20:5.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vidhuro hoti.
segments.an3.20:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati –
segments.an3.20:6.4: Tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañceva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañca uttānīkaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
segments.an3.20:6.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nissayasampanno hoti.
segments.an3.20:6.6: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva mahattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti kusalesu dhammesū”ti.

lines: Ettakaṃ mūlaṃ bhavissati ettako udayoti tasmiṃ “evaṃ kītaṃ evaṃ vikkāyamānan”ti vuttapaṇiye yena kayena taṃ kītaṃ, taṃ kayasaṅkhātaṃ mūlaṃ ettakaṃ bhavissati.
Yo ca tasmiṃ vikkayamāne vikkayo, tasmiṃ vikkaye ettako udayo bhavissati, ettikā vaḍḍhīti attho.
Kusalo hoti paṇiyaṃ ketuñca vikketuñcāti sulabhaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā kiṇanto dullabhaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā vikkiṇanto ca ettha kusalo nāma hoti, dasaguṇampi vīsatiguṇampi lābhaṃ labhati.
Paṭibaloti kāyabalena ceva ñāṇabalena ca samannāgatattā samattho.
Amhākañca kālena kālaṃ anuppadātunti amhākañca gahitadhanamūlikaṃ vaḍḍhiṃ kālena kālaṃ anuppadātuṃ.
Anikkhittadhuroti “aggamaggaṃ apāpuṇitvā imaṃ vīriyadhuraṃ na ṭhapessāmī”ti evaṃ aṭṭhapitadhuro.
Bahussutāti ekanikāyādivasena bahu buddhavacanaṃ sutaṃ etesanti bahussutā.
Āgatāgamāti eko nikāyo eko āgamo nāma, dve nikāyā dve āgamā nāma, pañca nikāyā pañca āgamā nāma, etesu āgamesu yesaṃ ekopi āgamo āgato paguṇo pavattito, te āgatāgamā nāma.
Diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaparamatthabhedañhi yena sutena ijjhati, taṃ sutaṃ nāma.
Abhidhamme āgatā kusalādikkhandhādibhedabhinnā dhammā suttantapiṭakepi otarantīti “dhammadharāti suttantapiṭakadharā” icceva vuttaṃ.
Na hi ābhidhammikabhāvena vinā nippariyāyato suttantapiṭakaññutā sambhavati.
